title: No payload access before the signature is verified
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards; HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation. QR Code Generation, 11. Verifying: the same steps upwards: “Verify the signature before processing the payload.”. HCERT Specification, 6.3 Input Data Validation: “The Issuer Signature SHALL also be verified before any processing of the contents of the HCERT takes place.”.

statements.label: No payload access before the signature is verified
statements.requirement: The API SHALL make the payload and claims reachable only through a successful verification result type. Code that inspects an unverified payload SHALL go through an explicitly named unsafe or diagnostic call.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-VER-002 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-VER-001 STT-VER-002 a tampered payload fails at the signature, before any payload is read` (VerifyTest.kt)).
